idea: Add a short migration preflight prompt before an agent proposes a database migration.
mechanism_hypothesis: Explicitly asking for data-loss, rollback, compatibility, and deployment constraints before design will reduce critical migration omissions without changing the model, tools, or execution topology.
intended_scope: repositories with deterministic migration and compatibility checks
known_non_goals: improvement outside the declared migration task strata

lineage.change_summary: Deliberately simple Contract v0 transfer fixture.
